name: newsletter
description: Email capture block with inline or stacked layout, pending state, success and failure feedback.
designIntent: Resource hubs and articles all need a newsletter block with the same validation, consent copy and status feedback. Newsletter owns the field and state while the caller owns the CRM and double opt-in.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible or screen-reader label for the email field.

props.name: successMessage
props.defaultValue: Thanks. Check your inbox to confirm.

props.name: errorMessage
props.defaultValue: Something went wrong. Please try again.
props.description: Failure message used when onSubmit rejects.

props.name: consent
props.description: Consent or privacy copy shown under the form.

props.name: onSubmit
props.description: Submit handler. Omit for a presentational form.

props.name: layout
props.description: Inline on desktop or always stacked.

examples.title: Owner newsletter
examples.code:
<Newsletter
  title="Weekly exit insights"
  description="One email a week. No spam."
  consent="By subscribing you agree to the privacy policy."
  onSubmit={async (email) => subscribe(email)}
/>
examples.description: Inline email capture with consent copy.

antiPatterns.title: Don't put the transport in the component
antiPatterns.explanation: Newsletter owns the field and status only. Pass a submit handler so the caller controls the CRM, double opt-in and error mapping.
antiPatterns.example:
// Avoid fetching a vendor endpoint inside Newsletter
<Newsletter title="Join" />

accessibility.implementation: The label is associated with the input and visible to screen readers
Success uses aria-live polite; errors use role alert
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide short success and error messages

compositionRules.relationship: Place Newsletter inside a Section or a Card

files.content:

export type { NewsletterProps } from './Newsletter';
